主要内容: HENRY SCHEIN, INC. disclosed in a Form 8-K filing dated February 14, 2018, that it provided a Question & Answer (Q&A) document regarding allegations made by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission on February 12, 2018. The Q&A is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the filing and is not deemed "filed" for any purpose, including under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The information in the Q&A is not incorporated by reference into any filing under the Exchange Act or the Securities Act of 1933. The filing also includes Exhibit 99.1, which outlines the Q&A on the FTC lawsuit. The filing was signed by Walter Siegel, Senior Vice President and General Counsel of HENRY SCHEIN, INC., on February 14, 2018.
